item.text: The reference appears to be a rectangular block with proportions about 100 × 48 × 55, four cross-drilled holes, and three vertical semicircular grooves on the opposite face. I’ve mapped that face to +Y and will check the orientation in the preview.

The preview matches the block’s orientation and hole layout. I also added the wider recesses visible at the tops of the three grooves. The model validates as one solid; I’ll run the final check and export the STEP file.
